mission: ZonicMe empowers Africans through the creative economy — building apps that turn fashion, art, media and everyday planning into real opportunity across the continent and diaspora.

ingest.note: Set window.ZONICME_INGEST_URL or localStorage zonicme_ingest_url to override.

apps.name: MyYanga
apps.summary:
African fashion discovery, Virtual Wear, and Runway.
Creators and shoppers meet in one orbit.
apps.detail: MyYanga is ZonicMe’s fashion platform — browse looks, try Virtual Wear, and follow Runway drops from African designers and the diaspora. Discovery meets commerce so creators earn and audiences find style that feels like home.

apps.name: MyAfriArt
apps.summary:
African art marketplace — discover, stage, collect.
Galleries and collectors in one place.
apps.detail: MyAfriArt connects artists, galleries, and collectors across Africa and the diaspora. Discover original work, stage digital exhibitions, and collect with confidence — a marketplace built for the continent’s creative voice.

apps.name: Rubba
apps.summary:
Life-planning for goals, savings, milestones.
Turn ambition into a clear next step.
apps.detail: Rubba helps people plan life with clarity — goals, savings targets, and milestones in one calm workspace. Built for everyday Africans who want structure without complexity, and progress they can see.

apps.name: AdSpot
apps.summary:
Media & partner ads with rewarded attention.
Brands reach real people, audiences earn.
apps.detail: AdSpot is the orbit’s media and partner network. Rewarded attention means brands reach consented audiences while users earn value — transparent, fair, and tuned for African markets and diaspora reach.

apps.name: OwanbeX
apps.summary:
Plan Nigerian celebrations end-to-end.
Vendors, budgets, aso ebi, guest lists.
apps.detail: OwanbeX helps families and brands plan weddings, birthdays, and milestone events across Nigeria — vetted vendors, live Naira budgets, aso ebi coordination, and brand analytics in one planner.
